subject: Confidentiality & brand-usage carveouts — MSA / Order Form redline coordination
messages:
From: Rachel Lee <rachel.lee@prospectco.com>

Date: 2028-05-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ProspectCo redlines — confidentiality and logo use

Hi Avery —

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood’s platform yesterday. Legal attached a redline of the Master Services Agreement and a small exhibit for logo/reference usage. Two quick asks from our side:

1) We need a carveout for customer case studies that share high-level performance metrics (no raw PII).
2) We ask to limit Redwood’s publicity to a ‘reference opt-in’ rather than blanket marketing rights — we prefer customer approval prior to quoting and logo use, with a 10 business day approval window.

I’ve attached the redline (ProspectCo_redline_MSA_v2.docx) and a PDF callout of the proposed exhibit. Kumar and I can join a 30-min sync if that helps. Please confirm your review timeline — we’re hoping to sign by end of month.

Best,
Rachel Lee
Director, Strategic Procurement
ProspectCo

Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-17T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ProspectCo redlines — confidentiality and logo use

Rachel —

Thanks for sending and great meeting yesterday. Looping in Olga (legal) and Markus (marketing) to take the lead on the redlines. Quick reply with timelines:

- Internal legal will turn around comments by EOD 5/18.
- Marketing will review Exhibit B and propose a short alternative that keeps the opt-in flow but allows an internal one-touch approval for pre-agreed collateral (e.g., case study headlines).

Olga — can you review the confidentiality carveout for metrics (item 1) and advise whether we can accept a limited-case carveout that excludes Personally Identifiable Information and requires aggregated thresholds?

Markus — for the approval window (10 business days) — would Redwood be comfortable with a shorter SLA (5 business days) for standard collateral and the 10 days for anything requiring legal review? If so, we can propose that to ProspectCo.

I’ll also propose a 30-min redline sync for Monday 5/20 at 10:00 AM PT unless you prefer another slot.

Thanks —
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com, Rachel Lee <rachel.lee@prospectco.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-17T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ProspectCo redlines — confidentiality and logo use

Avery / Rachel —

Thanks — I reviewed the attached MSA redline. High-level positions below and inline comments are in the attached PDF (ProspectCo-press-exhibit-comments.pdf):

1) Confidentiality carveout for aggregated metrics: acceptable if we add three safeguards — (a) anonymization/aggregation threshold (no <50-user buckets), (b) explicit prohibition on publishing raw logs or examples with user identifiers, and (c) right to redact any quoted metric on security grounds.

2) Opt-in reference flow: we prefer a single opt-in with a 5 business day approval window for routine collateral and 10 business days for materials that include ProspectCo logos or financials. This aligns with our marketing capacity and avoids indefinite holds.

3) Logo use: we cannot accept evergreen trademark grants. Instead, propose a limited license tied to each approved asset plus a revocation clause if ProspectCo requests removal with 30 days to effect.

4) Evidence and audit requests: ProspectCo’s SOC 2 / data handling references are reasonable; require proof via a secure link to the SOC report or a redacted copy in our secure drive (we’ll treat as confidential).

Action items:
- Avery: confirm the 5/10 approval windows to ProspectCo and propose the redline sync on Monday.
- Markus: please draft a concise Exhibit B (1 page) that captures the approval SLA, sample asset types, and the limited license language.

I attached inline comments to the MSA — major changes are tracked, so please route the updated doc back to me when you have Marcus’ exhibit language.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ProspectCo-press-exhibit-comments.pdf
From: Kumar Patel <kumar.p@prospectco.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: Rachel Lee <rachel.lee@prospectco.com>
Date: 2028-05-18T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ProspectCo redlines — confidentiality and logo use

Olga / Avery —

Appreciate the quick review. We’re fine with an anonymization threshold and agree that raw logs should remain private. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- The 5 business day window would be tight for our marketing + legal; can we do 7 business days for standard collateral and 12 business days for logo/financial items? Our head of comms is on leave next week and we want to avoid automatic approvals.

- For logo revocation, 30 days is acceptable provided existing public assets are taken down within that window and Redwood stops further distribution. We can agree to a clear takedown procedure in Exhibit B.

We uploaded a signed copy of our standard PO for the order form to DocuSign (link below). We can also send a redlined PDF export if that helps.

Regards,
Kumar Patel
Procurement Operations
ProspectCo

Date: 2028-05-18T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ProspectCo redlines — confidentiality and logo use

All —

Thanks for the back-and-forth. Quick internal confirmation and plan to send ProspectCo this afternoon:

1) Approval SLA: propose compromise — 7 business days for standard collateral, 10 business days for assets with logos/financials. That matches Redwood’s bandwidth and ProspectCo’s request.
2) Metrics carveout: we will accept aggregated/thresholded metrics with the three safeguards Olga listed. I’ll add explicit language that Redwood must notify ProspectCo before publishing metrics that could plausibly be re-identified.
3) Logo license: one-off asset-by-asset license in Exhibit B + 30-day revocation takedown. Markus to attach the Exhibit B draft.
4) Evidence: ask ProspectCo to share SOC 2 via secure link; we’ll treat it as confidential.

Olga / Markus — can you finalize the two-paragraph exhibit and the short redline snippet for the MSA by EOD so I can return a consolidated counter to Rachel & Kumar this afternoon? If not, I’ll propose a Monday 5/20 redline sync.

Avery
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
